description: An Angular component for configuring trace collection parameters within an application, including toggling trace targets, enabling configurations, and setting selection options.

classes.name: TraceConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing UI for configuring tracing options, including toggling trace targets and customizing trace configurations.

methods.name: advancedConfigTraces
methods.description: Returns a list of trace keys that have additional configuration options available.

methods.name: traceEnableConfigs
methods.description: Returns the enable configurations for a given trace, or an empty list if none are available.

methods.name: traceSelectionConfigs
methods.description: Returns the selection configurations for a given trace, or an empty list if none are available.

methods.name: someTraces
methods.description: Determines if any traces are enabled but not yet run, indicating partial activation.

methods.name: changeRunTrace
methods.description: Handles toggling the run state for a specific trace, updating associated configurations if necessary.

methods.name: changeTraceCollectionConfig
methods.description: Updates the trace's run status based on the enable configurations when trace collection parameters change.
